propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the settlement rules and partner rate tables in the settlement tool, logging each rate change with its contract reference.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the rule and rate-table maintenance directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated partner disputes with partner management and accounts payable and recorded who owned which part of the dispute.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the dispute coordination and the recorded boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owned the weekly partner settlement run, released payment files under a delegated limit of 400,000 and led the weekly settlement review.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the release log and the reference state the ownership, the limit and the review leadership.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions after each settlement run are only partly documented in the review log.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: release within the 400,000 limit and the settlement review; runs above the limit were co-released by the divisional finance manager.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded after each settlement run.
